text:
jules: Quick ping — aggregate p99 for /v1/chat shot to ~680ms at 14:07 but endpoint slice p99 shows ~240ms. anyone know why aggregate is so much higher?
rafi: my money is on sample origin mismatch or retries. did you include proxy-origin samples?
jules: used the dashboard default. i expected same semantics for both views.
meera: we changed endpoint slices last week to default to server-origin only. aggregate keeps all origins.
zack: confirmable in logs: `ingress: endpoint=/v1/chat origin=proxy fallback=true latency_ms=667 retry_count=1 route=eu-central`
rafi: that explains it. fallback/proxy path + retries will inflate aggregate p99.
jules: console didn't show any provenance indicator on the percentile row, so it looked like a backend regression.
meera: UX fix proposal: add a small provenance pill next to p50/p95/p99 values and a hover that lists counts and percentiles by origin.
zack: also add an "exclude retries" toggle to the percentile query. telemetry already tags `retry_count` and `sample_origin`.
rafi: minimal reproducible query to attach to the incident: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, sample_origin, count(*) FROM telemetry.samples WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND time >= '2026-03-22T14:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-22T14:15Z' GROUP BY sample_origin ORDER BY p99 DESC;`
deploy-bot: rollout: canary/2026-03-22.14 applied to eu-central at 14:04
jules: action items: (1) console: provenance pill + hover counts (meera), (2) telemetry API: include_retries param defaulting to false (rafi), (3) docs blurb on why percentiles differ across slices (zack).
meera: i'll open the UI PR today; low-risk change.
rafi: i'll wire the query flag and return origin breakdown in the percentile response.
zack: i'll draft the docs blurb and link it from the hover.
jules: thanks — filing an incident note referencing the query and a couple trace samples.
